points.label: Audience and responsibility
points.left: Jesus speaks about oaths tied to heaven, earth, Jerusalem, and one’s own head. He points to human limits and calls for a plain yes or no. He says anything beyond this comes from the evil one.
points.right: The scene disputes descent from Abraham, attempted killing, and true fatherhood. It also names desire, murder, truth, lies, hearing, and belonging.

payload.posture: Read both WEBU passages side by side. Keep each passage’s actors, setting, order, and identity claims distinct.

rightEvidence.title: Jesus describes the devil as father of lies while contesting desire and hearing

payload.tension: Both link the hostile figure with speech. Both still hold the human speaker responsible.
payload.title: Speech from the evil one and the father of lies
